extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 970dc88bd1bfcbc77d798e6ee4a6a0e55119ab1023a26331bc8a11929662b657 before extraction.

Identity: target MPN HT8050ARTZ (HTCSEMI); the public datasheet is titled HT8050A, Rev. 00. The RTZ suffix is a packing/reel code not restated in the datasheet; the Classification of HFE box (Range 200~350, rank A) is the A rank this MPN belongs to.
All scalar specs are transcribed from the p. 1 tables at Ta = 25 degC with min/max meanings preserved in source_kind; guaranteed bounds were never converted to typicals.

Curve points are manual readings of plotted positions against the printed grid from the p. 2 typical-characteristics figures, taken from 300 dpi renders; readings are grid-anchored with roughly 5-10 percent uncertainty between gridlines, and no points were extrapolated beyond plotted curve ends.
Units converted to SI: mA to A, MHz to Hz, pF to F, mV to V. Axis scales are preserved as printed (log axes noted).
The VCEsat - IC figure shows Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC curves nearly coincident; only the 25 degC curve was digitized.
The IC - VBE (Gummel-style) figure on p. 2 was examined but not digitized; the remaining figures cover the F1 package needs.
cobo and cibo have no table entries in this datasheet; both are supplied from the clearly readable Cob/Cib typical curves and marked digitized_typical_curve.
Datasheet prints the ICEO test condition as VCB = 20 V, IE = 0, which appears to be a typographical slip for VCE = 20 V, IB = 0; transcribed here only as a note since ICEO is not a schema field.
Maximum ratings for reference: VCBO 40 V, VCEO 25 V, VEBO 5 V, IC 1.5 A continuous, PC 0.3 W, Tj 150 degC, Tstg -55 to 150 degC (p. 1).
